title: Enna Vilai Trailer Out: Karunas, Nimisha Sajayan
excerpt: Official trailer for Enna Vilai — premieres Oct 15, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Enna Vilai dropped October 14, 2026.
  • New movie premiering Oct 15, 2026 on Netflix India.
  • What happens when a fisherman finds more trouble than treasure?
  • Out in Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu — pick your language below.

The makers of Enna Vilai have released the official trailer, unveiled October 14, 2026.

Karunas and Nimisha Sajayan lead the cast, with Vijayalakshmi Veeramani, Shashaa Shivakumar, Kamalesh Jagan and Mohan Raman. Sajeev Pazhoor writes and directs the Tamil social drama, in his directorial debut. The film opened in theaters on September 17, 2026, and arrives on Netflix on October 15.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wl4mqPQCBnU

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
